modalities.evidence: single-lead ECG signals captured at the thighs

output.population: 149 recordings from 86 individuals (50 females, 36 males), average age 31.73 ± 13.11 years, recruited via a hospital principal investigator and clinical consultations
output.summary: Single-lead thigh ECG recorded by electrodes embedded in a toilet seat, with reference signals from a standard 12-lead hospital ECG system, for research on "invisible" ECG cardiovascular assessment.
